gloss: right to run for office; eligibility for election

definitions.gloss: right to run for office; eligibility for election; passive suffrage
definitions.explanation: The legal right to stand as a candidate in an election. In Japan, the minimum age for this right varies by office: 25 for the House of Representatives and local assemblies, 30 for the House of Councillors and prefectural governors.

examples.japanese: {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧25⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: The right to run for office starts at age 25.

examples.japanese: {参議院議員|さんぎいんぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30{歳以上|さいいじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The eligibility to run for the House of Councillors is set at age 30 or older.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧18⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げられた→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}し→対する：02126_taisuru⟧、{被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{変|か}わっていない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: While the voting age was lowered to 18, the age requirement for the right to run for office still hasn't changed.

notes:
Compound of {被|ひ} (passive; receiving) + ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ (election) + {権|けん} (right). Literally the right to "be elected," contrasting with ⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧, the right to vote ("to elect"). The {被|ひ} prefix marks the passive side of the election process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have the right to run for office
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧: age of eligibility for candidacy
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose eligibility to run for office
- {被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ→引き下げ：12553_hikisage⟧: lowering of candidacy age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧: right to vote, active suffrage
- ⟦{参政権|さんせいけん}→参政権：18066_sanseiken⟧: political rights, the broader concept encompassing both voting and candidacy
- {公民権|こうみんけん}: civil rights
